$comment: Balance data for engine.education (MOD-041). §27 describes the education lifecycle's direction and mechanism only — it gives NO numeric magnitude for drift-per-quality-unit, attainment weighting, research-points-per-graduate, halls capacity, or the fork/university/adult/U3A age gates. Every number here is a PLACEHOLDER pending the M2 balance pass (GR#15's balance-number regime: player-felt numbers are placeholders + directional tests until Aaron rules). The only spec-stated magnitudes are the primary (5y = 60 months) and secondary (11y = 132 months) entry ages, transcribed from §27; leave-at-16 pins the fork gate at 16y = 192 months. entryAgeMonths is keyed by the stage names Stage.String() renders and is an age in MONTHS of the citizen (birthMonth-derived, matching engine.citizens' derived Age()).
